'''Ardis Outpost''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] during the [[Galactic War]]. It was [[Attack on Ardis Outpost|attacked unsuccessfully]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
